id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|309: It's a book called "History of the Ice Kingdom of Sniflheim."
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|310: Sniflheim, in the north of Erdrea, was an uncharted land that refused visitors with endless snowfields and freezing cold.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|321: But when an explorer wandered deep into Snaerfelt, all changed. He found humanity's wisdom: the ancient library.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|333: With the discovery of the many books in the ancient library, researchers, mages and thinkers rushed to Sniflheim.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|345: They declared this land a holy ground of learning, which became the foundation of today's Kingdom of Sniflheim.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|357: "Such a tragedy once happened here... {var:1}, I'm concerned about Erik. Go check on him.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|385: It's a swimsuit photo book called "Summer in Paradise."
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|38c: Photos of lively swimsuit-clad girls jumping on a beach under the dazzling summer sun.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|397: Wow! The endless-summer paradise! Summer, hot, god of summer! The Swimming Contest of Lively Girls!
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|3a4: This book seems packed with the dreams and hopes of those living in snow country.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|3bc: It's a book called "A Certain Treasure Hunter's Message, Chapter 4."
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|3c3: I'm a nameless treasure hunter. I came to Sniflheim seeking a wise person who knows where the rainbow branch is.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|3d0: But here I'll change my journey's purpose. Just before entering this country, I saved a young man collapsed in the snow.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|3df: The young man seems delirious with fever, repeating the same words like ravings: "I'm going home..."
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|3ee: Watching him, I recalled my own long-unvisited home, and couldn't leave him be.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|3fd: So I'll pause the rainbow branch hunt and take this young man home.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|407: An old doctor from the desert country I met at a tavern will come along. A relief. Travel brings companions and kindness.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|424: It's a tourist pamphlet called "A Walker's Guide to Sniflheim."
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|42c: Snowflakes are light and fluffy, but deep snow is different. It is pressed harder and harder into heavy ice.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|43a: If that much heavy ice piled on an ordinary house, it could not bear the weight and would be crushed flat.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|446: But Sniflheim's solidly built houses do not budge. They endure the snow's weight and await the thaw.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|455: The buildings of Sniflheim can be called the wisdom of the forebears who protected and nurtured this snowy land.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|46b: "...{var:1}, could you come with me for a moment?
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|48f: The great tree's root simply stretches from the ground. Its glow has faded, and looking at it seems to do nothing.
id./param/region/r012.pack|book_ie.bxon|4b0: You gave Lilian's granddaughter Lily her diploma. Report to Ms. Milligan on the Medal Academy's second floor.

tm.「どうも 気分が 乗らなくてね。\n オレは ここで 待ってるから\n お前は: "I'm just not in the mood. I'll wait here, so you go see the Queen quickly.
tm.たき火が 燃えている。\n身体が すこしだけ あたたまった。: A bonfire is burning. Your body warms up a little.
tm.魔女が起こした たき火だ。\n身体が すこしだけ あたたまった。: A bonfire lit by the witch. Your body warms up a little.
tm.「……むむ。待たれよ。\n 夜間 城に入ることは 禁じられている。\n 日をあら: "...Hm. Wait. Entering the castle at night is forbidden. Please visit again in daylight.
tm.「……おっと 待つんだ。\n 現在 地下につながる昇降機は 使用禁止でな。\n: "...Oh, wait. The lift to the underground is currently off limits. Sorry, but I can't let you through.
tm.城が 氷漬けになっている。\n中に入ることは できないようだ。: The castle is frozen in ice. It seems you can't go inside.
tm.扉が 氷漬けになっている。\nとても 開きそうにない。: The door is frozen in ice. It doesn't look like it will open.
tm.「あら ステキな お兄さん！\n ぱふぱふ する？: "Oh, what a lovely man! Want a puff-puff?
tm.「それじゃあ 明日の昼間\n 港の桟橋の手前辺りに来てね。: "Then come tomorrow in the daytime, near the front of the harbor pier.
tm.「あら 来たわね お兄さん。\n さっそく ぱふぱふする？: "Oh, you came, sweetie. Shall we do the puff-puff right away?
tm.「あら 心の準備が できてないの？\n じゃあ 待ってるから また\n 声をかけ: "Oh, not mentally ready? Then I'll wait. Talk to me again.
tm.「あら くるしかった？\n ごめんなさいね。: "Oh, was that hard to breathe? Sorry.
tm.「あたし メイクアップの 勉強を\n してるんだけど 不器用だから\n 粉が ま: "I'm studying makeup, but I'm clumsy so the powder flies everywhere...
tm.「女の人だと なかなか 協力して\n くれないのよ。なぜかしらね？: "Women don't cooperate much. I wonder why?
tm.「早く 一人前になって\n サマディーの サーカスメイクを\n まかされてみたい: "I want to become a full-fledged artist quickly and be trusted with the Gallopolis Circus makeup!
tm.「港の方だけでなく 町の往来にも\n 人々の姿が 見当たらないわね……。: "There's no one at the harbor, nor on the town's streets...
tm.「建物の中からは 人の気配もするのだけど\n どうやら 何かに おびえていて\n: "I sense people inside the buildings, but they seem frightened of something, locked in with their doors bolted.
tm.「……私は このまま 町の様子を探ってみるわ。\n あなたは ロウさまと一緒に: "...I'll keep scouting the town. You go to the castle with Lord Rab and meet Charlotte.
tm.「前に クレイモランに来た時には\n この辺りも にぎやかな雰囲気だったのに\n: "When I visited Sniflheim before, this area was lively. Now there isn't a soul...
tm.「どうも みんな 家の中に隠れてるみたい。\n ……なんだか 不気味ねえ。\n: "It seems everyone is hiding indoors. ...How eerie. What on earth happened?
tm.「この広場には 住民たちの姿は無いようだ。\n これでは 何が起きているか\n: "There are no residents in this plaza. We have no way of knowing what's happening...
tm.「不思議なことに 家の中からは\n 住民の気配を感じるのだが\n 誰も 扉を開け: "Strangely, I sense the residents inside the houses, yet nobody opens their doors.
tm.「いったい どういうわけだ……。\n 俺たちは もう少し 町の様子を探ってみる。: "What in the world... We'll scout the town a bit more. {var:1}, I leave the castle to you.
tm.「……むう。どうしたというんじゃ。\n カミュの様子 ただごとではないぞ。\n: "...Hmm. What's wrong? Erik's behavior is not normal. Did something happen here once?
tm.「この部屋に 何か手がかりが\n 残されているかもしれん。\n {var:1}よ: "There may be clues left in this room. {var:1}, look around.
tm.「……神父殿が 言っていた通りじゃな。\n カミュは 妹と一緒に バイキングの手: "...Just as the priest said. Erik and his sister lived a hard life as the Vikings' underlings.
tm.「妹の名前は……マヤと言っておったか。\n カミュと彼女は この風穴の中で\n: "His sister's name was Maya, was it? Erik and she seem to have lived inside this cave...
tm.「……ふーむ {var:1}よ。\n ふたたび 大樹の根を調べてみるのじゃ。\n: "...Hmm, {var:1}. Examine the great tree's root again. You may see the rest of Erik's past.
tm.「……カミュと 妹のマヤ殿は\n 不器用ながらも お互いのことを\n 家族として: "...Erik and his sister Maya, clumsy as they were, cherished each other as family.
tm.「それにしても ものを黄金に変える首飾りとは\n 何やら 気になるのう……。: "Still, a necklace that turns things to gold... That bothers me.
tm.扉は かたく 閉ざされている。\nこの扉は どうやっても 開かないようだ。: The door is firmly shut. It doesn't seem to open no matter what.
tm.「待って {var:1}ちゃん！\n このまま カミュちゃんを放っておけないわ。: "Wait, {var:1}! We can't leave Erik like this. We have to gather information on where he was taken.
tm.「それに カミュちゃんを見ていてくれた\n あの神父さんのことも 心配よ。\n: "And I'm worried about the priest who looked after Erik. Let's go see him first.
tm.一度 凍った影響か\n本がしめって しわしわだ。\n文字がにじんで 読むことがで: Having once frozen, the book is damp and wrinkled. The ink has run and it can't be read.
tm.『氷の王国 クレイモランの歴史』という本だ。: It's a book called "History of the Ice Kingdom of Sniflheim."
tm.ロトゼタシアの北に位置する クレイモラン地方は\n果てしなく続く雪原と 氷点下の: Sniflheim, in the north of Erdrea, was an uncharted land that refused visitors with endless snowfields and freezing cold.
tm.しかし シケスビア雪原の奥地に\n探検家が迷い込んだことで 状況は一変する。\n: But when an explorer wandered deep into Snaerfelt, all changed. He found humanity's wisdom: the ancient library.
tm.古代図書館に眠っていた 多くの書物の発見で\n世界中の研究者 魔法使い 思想家た: With the discovery of the many books in the ancient library, researchers, mages and thinkers rushed to Sniflheim.
tm.彼らは この地を 学問の聖地と定め\n現在のクレイモラン王国 建国の\nいしずえ: They declared this land a holy ground of learning, which became the foundation of today's Kingdom of Sniflheim.
tm.「この場所で かつて あのような悲劇が……。\n {var:1}よ カミュのこと: "Such a tragedy once happened here... {var:1}, I'm concerned about Erik. Go check on him.
tm.『楽園のサマー』という 水着ギャルの写真集だ。: It's a swimsuit photo book called "Summer in Paradise."
tm.水着を着た ピチピチギャルたちが\n夏の日ざしが まぶしい砂浜で\n元気に ジャ: Photos of lively swimsuit-clad girls jumping on a beach under the dazzling summer sun.
tm.わおっ！ ここが 常夏の楽園！\n夏っ 暑っ 神サマー 仏サマー！\nピチピチギ: Wow! The endless-summer paradise! Summer, hot, god of summer! The Swimming Contest of Lively Girls!
tm.雪国に住む人の 夢と希望が\nこの本には たくさん つまっているようだ。: This book seems packed with the dreams and hopes of those living in snow country.
tm.『とあるトレジャーハンターの伝言 第４章』\nという本だ。: It's a book called "A Certain Treasure Hunter's Message, Chapter 4."
tm.私は ナナシのトレジャーハンター。\n虹色の枝のありかを知る 知恵者を探して\n: I'm a nameless treasure hunter. I came to Sniflheim seeking a wise person who knows where the rainbow branch is.
tm.しかし ここで 旅の目的を変えようと思う。\nこの国に入る すこし前 雪道で\n: But here I'll change my journey's purpose. Just before entering this country, I saved a young man collapsed in the snow.
tm.若者は 高熱で意識が はっきりしないようだが\nうわ言のように 同じ言葉を繰り返: The young man seems delirious with fever, repeating the same words like ravings: "I'm going home..."
tm.そんな 若者の様子を見ていたら\n私も 長いこと帰っていない 故郷を思いだし\n: Watching him, I recalled my own long-unvisited home, and couldn't leave him be.
tm.だから 虹色の枝探しは 休止して\nこの若者を故郷に 送りとどけようと思う。: So I'll pause the rainbow branch hunt and take this young man home.
tm.酒場で出会った 砂漠の国から来た老医師が\n同行してくれるそうなので ひと安心だ: An old doctor from the desert country I met at a tavern will come along. A relief. Travel brings companions and kindness.
tm.『クレイモランの歩き方』という\n観光案内用の冊子だ。: It's a tourist pamphlet called "A Walker's Guide to Sniflheim."
tm.雪の結晶は ふわふわと軽いものですが\n高くつもった雪は 違います。\nどんどん: Snowflakes are light and fluffy, but deep snow is different. It is pressed harder and harder into heavy ice.
tm.そんな 重い氷が 普通の家に\nたくさん乗れば 重みにたえられず\n家は ペチャ: If that much heavy ice piled on an ordinary house, it could not bear the weight and would be crushed flat.
tm.しかし しっかりと頑丈に作られた\nクレイモラン王国の家々は びくともしません。: But Sniflheim's solidly built houses do not budge. They endure the snow's weight and await the thaw.
tm.クレイモラン王国の建物は\n雪深い この国を守りはぐくんだ\n先人たちの 知恵と: The buildings of Sniflheim can be called the wisdom of the forebears who protected and nurtured this snowy land.
tm.「……{var:1}\n ちょっと オレについてきてくれないか？: "...{var:1}, could you come with me for a moment?
tm.大樹の根は ただ静かに 地面から伸びている。\nどうやら まとっていた光は おさ: The great tree's root simply stretches from the ground. Its glow has faded, and looking at it seems to do nothing.
tm.リリアンの孫娘 リリーに卒業証書を渡した。\nメダル女学園の２階の廊下にいる\n: You gave Lilian's granddaughter Lily her diploma. Report to Ms. Milligan on the Medal Academy's second floor.
